CDC analyzed data from an Internet panel survey conducted March 31–April 11, 2014.
Vaccination coverage estimates from the Internet panel surveys completed for the 2010–11 through 2013–14 seasons were compared to assess trends over time.

methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to reflect the age, race/ethnicity, and geographic distribution of the total U.S. population of pregnant women.
Because the opt-in Internet panel sample is not probability-based, no statistical tests were performed.
Differences were noted when there was a difference of ≥5 percentage points between any values being compared.
Vaccination coverage estimates from the Internet panel surveys completed for the 2010–11 through 2013–14 seasons were compared to assess trends over time.
Vaccination coverage estimates were not reliable because sample size was <30.
